_comment: FSRS-6 default (un-personalized) weights and target retention (ANA-PLAN §18.1: 'açık kaynak ve güncel FSRS algoritması kullanılmalı'). Sourced from the open-spaced-repetition project's published reference (fsrs-optimizer), cross-checked against two independent copies of the algorithm spec before being used here — not a number chosen by this codebase. These are the generic defaults every fresh FSRS deployment starts from; they are NOT tuned to this user's own review history (no history exists yet). A future personalization step (running the optimizer against this user's own ReviewLog data) would replace this file, not the code that reads it (§0.6).
